human_summary: Capacity Loss Service Decay is compatible with 1 edge(s) in this graph. This inspection is a pre-binding review, not a binding decision.

evidence.support_fragment: A housing complex boiler shut down during a cold evening and several units lost heat.

required_preconditions_before_simulation: The graph must identify an enabling dependency and an affected service outcome or state.
The binding must state which non-capacity influences are omitted.
missing_preconditions: A human-authored binding must provide required parameter intervals: degradation_rate
A state-variable mapping must attach template roles to graph nodes and units before simulation.

state_roles_to_map.description: Availability of the supporting capacity, normalized from zero to one.
Measurable outcome maintained by the capacity.

parameters_to_supply.description: Rate of service degradation when capacity availability is absent or reduced.

prior_predictive_signature: Full capacity availability implies no degradation attributable to capacity loss.
Complete loss of capacity produces monotonic service degradation under the isolated template.
forbidden_inferences: Do not treat a repair request as recovered capacity unless restoration is observed.
Do not conclude that capacity loss is the sole cause of measured degradation.

compression_view.disclosure: Compresses enabling infrastructure and consequence transmission into capacity availability versus service state.
